messages:
Jordan (Product): quick design check — finalizing the prompt-evals approval flow. I sketched a compact scorecard that pushes the primary CTA to the top-right. sync at 3pm. can we do a quick pass on copy + accessibility before the meeting?
Sana (Design): on it. main thing: CTA placement feels visually cramped in the header when there are long prompt names. also keyboard order matters — header actions get focused first currently.
Kai (Frontend): agreed. on narrow widths the CTA overlaps the overflow menu. I can change CSS but need a decision: move CTA under the scorecard rows or keep in header and truncate names?
Ravi (DevEx): prefer keeping primary CTA consistent across pages. if we move it, can we keep a sticky action bar on mobile? that avoids jumping layout.
a11y-bot: Automated check: contrast ratio for button text "Approve" on bg #e6f0ff -> 2.8:1 (WCAG AA fails). Suggested: #0b57d0 or increase weight.
Sana (Design): good catch @a11y-bot. Proposal A (header):
```
[Approve]   [Request changes]
Prompt suite title — author
Scorecard: 4/5 • regression diff
```
Proposal B (inline action):
```
Prompt suite title — author        [Approve]
Scorecard summary
```
Which one feels more discoverable? I lean B for long lists.
Jordan (Product): I'm leaning B too — inline actions reduce header clutter. but copy needs to be explicit: "Approve suite" vs just "Approve".
Kai (Frontend): small nit: avoid verbs-only buttons if the action could be ambiguous in a list. longer label affects layout though. maybe use a condensed label on mobile: `Approve` -> `Approve suite` on desktop, `Approve` on mobile via aria-label.
Ravi (DevEx): +1. also we need a tooltip for the approval that explains what triggers the rollout. short help text: "Approving pins this suite for regression checks and enables auto-run on new prompts."
Sana (Design): copy candidates:
- "Approve suite"
- "Approve and run tests"
- "Mark as approved"
I prefer first. second implies immediate run (we have separate run button).
Jordan (Product): prefer "Approve suite". Also we need aria-live announcement: "Suite approved" and a clear undo action in the toast.
a11y-bot: Reminder: toast must be focusable and keyboard-dismissable. Also ensure focus returns to a sensible place after approval.
Kai (Frontend): implementable. I'll prototype the inline CTA with `Approve suite` desktop + `Approve` mobile, add `aria-label` and the tooltip. will post a GIF in #design-sync.
Sana (Design): accessibility nit: make sure the scorecard diff chips have at least 3px separation for focus outlines. and use semantic `<button>` for the approve action.
Ravi (DevEx): QA checklist for rollout: keyboard + screen reader pass, contrast checks, regression tests for responsive breakpoints. I'll add to the deck.
Jordan (Product): trying to keep this tight for the sync — summary: use inline CTA (Proposal B), label `Approve suite`, keep separate "Run tests" CTA, add undo toast + aria-live, follow a11y-bot contrast suggestions. Kai/Ravi/Sana will iterate on prototype and I’ll review before 2:45pm. thanks! :thumbsup:
Sana (Design): ack — will update mocks now.
Kai (Frontend): pushing prototype branch in ~45m.
Ravi (DevEx): adding QA items to the checklist.
a11y-bot: Contrast re-check queued.
